notes:
A compound of ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ (free of charge) + ⟦{通話|つうわ}→通話：14369_tsuuwa⟧ (phone call). In modern usage, this term most commonly refers to free voice calls made through messaging apps (LINE, WhatsApp) or VoIP services, but it also applies to toll-free numbers and free calling minutes included in phone plans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: free calling app
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: free calling minutes (included in a plan)
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to make a free call
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: supports free calling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦フリー→フリー：11001_furii⟧⟦ダイヤル→ダイヤル：28313_daiyaru⟧: toll-free number (specifically a 0120-number that the receiver pays for)
- ⟦{通話料|つうわりょう}→通話料：16275_tsuuwaryou⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: call charges free (alternative phrasing; same meaning)
- {国際電話|こくさいでんわ}: international call (often contrasted with {無料通話|むりょうつうわ} apps that make international calls free)
